name: openflow
description: Session manager for large Ableton Live sets.
author: Ryan Gavin

scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:device
scripts.set: npm run build:set && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-electron.ts set && electron set
scripts.qa: export OPENFLOW_QA=1 && rm -rf release && npm run build && npm run pack && npm run install:apps && npm run install:device
scripts.pack: npm run pack:set && npm run pack:visuals
scripts.pack:set: npm run build:set && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-electron.ts set && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-icons.ts set && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --project set -c.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('./node_modules/electron/package.json').version") ${OPENFLOW_QA:+-c.mac.target=dir -c.mac.identity=null}
scripts.pack:visuals: npm run build:visuals && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-electron.ts visuals && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-icons.ts visuals && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --project visuals -c.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('./node_modules/electron/package.json').version") ${OPENFLOW_QA:+-c.mac.target=dir -c.mac.identity=null}
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,types,lom,set,bench,devices,vis-app,vis-ui,chart,chart-ui -c cyan,blue,magenta,green,yellow,red,white,gray,magentaBright,blueBright "node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/dev-bridge.ts" "tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.v8.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --config set/vite.config.ts" "vite --config widgets/vite.config.ts" "vite --config set/vite.bench.config.ts" "npm run dev:visuals-app" "vite --config visuals/vite.config.ts" "OPENFLOW_CHART_UI=http://127.0.0.1:5573 node --watch --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning chart/server/index.ts" "vite --config chart/vite.config.ts"
scripts.dev:set-app: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-electron.ts set && OPENFLOW_DEV=1 electron set
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.v8.json --noEmit && tsc -p core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p widgets/tsconfig.json && tsc -p set/tsconfig.json && tsc -p set/tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p visuals/tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p visuals/tsconfig.json && tsc -p chart/tsconfig.json
scripts.postinstall: cd bridge && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../visuals && npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:link && cd .. && npm run dev:check-singletons
scripts.visuals: npm run build:visuals && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-electron.ts visuals && electron visuals
scripts.dev:visuals-app: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/build-electron.ts visuals && OPENFLOW_DEV=1 electron visuals
